name: scenario-coverage-convergence
description: Drive a declarative device-test corpus to an honest, converged verdict board — then grow it: converge the suite (repeated resume passes with environment guards), triage every residual into app-bug / drift / selector / environment / by-design, fan out authoring agents to convert operator-stub scenarios into runnable ones, re-converge with the enlarged corpus, and gate the final board + new coverage on human review. Built from a real campaign where one long fragile run produced 200+ junk verdicts that hid real regressions; the convergence-loop + triage split is the antidote.

vars.corpusDir: path to the declarative scenario corpus
vars.schemaPath: path to the corpus JSON schema
vars.validateCmd: command that validates the whole corpus (non-zero on invalid)
vars.runCmd: resume-capable suite invocation (keeps prior PASS verdicts cached)
vars.healthChecks: list of {name, cmd} liveness probes (app server, bundler, devices)
vars.recycleCmd: restarts UI drivers / cold-starts the app / re-boots devices
vars.loginRestoreCmd: optional: verify + restore device auth state
vars.passCapMinutes: wall-clock cap per pass (the driver-rot window)
vars.manifestGlob: per-test verdict artifacts (reason, screenshots, output tail)
vars.appSrcDir: application source root (selector verification + drift checks)
vars.maxStubConversions: cap on stub conversions per run, e.g. 12
vars.evidencePageSpec: where and how to publish the human-review evidence page: destination + layout + staging command. The page MUST show FULL coverage: one capture per scenario per platform for the entire corpus (final/goal screen for every PASS, failure screen for every FAIL, visually distinguished), grouped by surface/area with per-capture captions. Per-surface samples or text-only verdict bands are non-compliant — reviewers confirm design and flow flaws from the captures, so the round covers the whole app

phases.name: materialize-config
phases.description: vars are visible to code nodes, not to prompt interpolation — materialize the suite config into state so prompts can read ${cfg.*} (the established pattern).

phases.name: baseline-converge
phases.description: Converge the suite as-is: repeated resume passes with environment guards until a pass banks nothing new. Produces the trustworthy baseline board.
phases.prompt: EXECUTE NOW — do not ask questions. Run your convergence loop exactly as your agent definition describes, using this concrete config: ${cfg}. Launch suite passes DETACHED and poll their logs every 2-3 minutes (short commands = visible progress). Stop when a pass banks no new PASS, then output the verdict board.

phases.name: triage
phases.description: Classify every residual non-PASS with artifact evidence: app-bug / test-drift / selector / environment / by-design. App bugs exit to the delivery pipeline; the rest feed coverage work. Evidence-heavy: screenshot hygiene (downscaled copies, small batches) makes this slower than default phase caps.

phases.name: select-stubs
phases.prompt: SELECTION MODE — do not convert anything yet. From the corpus at ${cfg.corpusDir}, list the operator-stub scenarios (placeholder machine steps, prose recipes in notes) whose prerequisites now exist: verify each recipe's selectors/fixtures against ${cfg.appSrcDir} and the triage report (${triage}). Output ONLY a JSON array of at most ${cfg.maxStubConversions} items, each {"id": scenario-id, "file": path, "why": one-line readiness evidence} — highest-confidence first. Stale buckets are normal: ids named as missing in old notes often exist by now; source is the only truth.
phases.description: Pick the convertible stubs — prerequisites verified in source, capped per run.

phases.name: sanitize-stub-queue
phases.description: Balanced-bracket extraction of the first JSON array in the selector's output (agents wrap arrays in prose/fences; a greedy regex spans stray brackets).

code.source: const s=String(input); const i=s.indexOf('['); if(i<0) return '[]'; let d=0, inStr=false, esc=false; for(let j=i;j<s.length;j++){const c=s[j]; if(esc){esc=false;continue;} if(c==='\\'){esc=true;continue;} if(c==='"'){inStr=!inStr;continue;} if(inStr)continue; if(c==='[')d++; else if(c===']'){d--; if(d===0){const cand=s.slice(i,j+1); try{return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(cand));}catch(e){return '[]';}}}} return '[]';

phases.name: convert-stubs
phases.description: Fan the authoring agents over the selected stubs. Serial-capped: corpus files are shared state and validators race.

body.name: author-stub
body.prompt: Convert this one stub scenario to runnable steps: ${item}. Corpus schema: ${cfg.schemaPath}. Validate with ${cfg.validateCmd}. Verify every selector in ${cfg.appSrcDir} before authoring. Re-bucket only on a clean validate; otherwise append a dated one-line blocker to its notes and leave the bucket unchanged.

phases.name: validate-corpus
phases.prompt: GATE MODE: run ${cfg.validateCmd} on the full corpus and report PASS/FAIL with the output tail. If invalid, identify which converted scenario broke it and fix ONLY that file, then re-validate. Output the final validate status.
phases.description: The corpus must validate as a whole before it is allowed near devices.

phases.name: re-converge
phases.description: Converge again with the enlarged corpus — newly-converted scenarios earn real verdicts; regressions in conversions surface here, not in review.
phases.prompt: EXECUTE NOW — do not ask questions or list caveats. Run the convergence loop again with this concrete config: ${cfg} (resume mode keeps banked verdicts; the newly-converted scenarios get their first real verdicts). Detached passes + short polls. Output the final verdict board with per-pass deltas.

phases.name: review-gate
phases.prompt: Prepare the human-review packet: final board ${finalBoard} vs baseline ${baselineBoard} (delta table), the conversions that went green vs those that failed their first run (with evidence), the remaining by-design blocked list with each gate's justification, and the ranked app-bug list from ${triage}. Be explicit about what is NOT covered and why. Then PUBLISH the packet per ${cfg.evidencePageSpec}: verdict bands PLUS per-surface goal screenshots for every platform tested, sourced from the run manifests' screenshot paths, each captioned surface + scenario id. A text-only evidence page violates the spec — humans review flaws in design and flow from the captures, not from counts.
phases.description: Human approval on the board delta + new coverage before anything ships downstream.
